# Beerolog

> Beerolog helps a person learn their taste, get strong beer recommendations, and refine their profile over time. Signed-in solo flow: sign in, complete a 7-question taste quiz, get menu-scoped recommendations, rate beers, and keep an evolving taste profile.

Beerolog is an auth-gated app (Clerk). Pages require sign-in; the API requires a Clerk session token.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](https://beerolog.com/): taste-profile summary, time-aware greeting, onboarding CTA
- [Onboarding quiz](https://beerolog.com/onboarding): 7-question taste quiz (coffee, water, snacks, novelty, sour, citrus, smoked)
- [Recommendations](https://beerolog.com/recommendations): top beer picks from saved taste profile + optional vibe context
- [Sign in](https://beerolog.com/signin): Clerk authentication

## API

Base URL is set per deployment (VITE_API_URL). Endpoints require a Clerk session token unless noted.

- `GET /health`: liveness probe (public)
- `GET /health/ready`: readiness probe with per-component status (public)
- `POST /onboarding`: submit 7 quiz answers; persists baseline taste profile
- `GET /recommendations`: menu-scoped beer recommendations for the user
- `POST /ratings`: record a beer rating to evolve the taste profile
- `GET /icons`: icon metadata for the catalog

## Out of scope

No venue/scan flows, group sessions, friend challenges, leaderboards, badges, or bar-operator tooling.
